plugins.name: first-customer-finder
plugins.description: Find and qualify evidence-backed first customers, early adopters, or design partners for a startup from recent public pain and buying signals, and produce a shareable HTML prospecting report. Never sends outreach automatically.

plugins.name: startend
plugins.description: Umbrella plugin for Startend craft skills, namespaced by domain prefix. Currently ships design-leading-trim: optical trimming of the line box (text-box-trim) for text that sits off-centre inside a block or drifts from the vertical rhythm because of font metrics.

plugins.name: design-system
plugins.description: Build and hold a design system: inventory an existing UI, define three-tier tokens, keep a registry of components, patterns and page templates, publish a live showcase and guard it in CI.
